Subject: Provisional offer for Sophie Park — proposed comp + routing

Hi team,

Posting this thread so we have a clear record before I send Sophie the formal package. Quick summary of the proposed terms we discussed on the debrief:

- Title: Senior ML Engineer (IC3)
- Base salary: $175,000
- Bonus: 10% target
- Equity: 0.6% RSU, 4-year vesting, 1-yr cliff
- Start window: flexible — target 2027-03-29 but candidate asked about earlier if feasible (late March preferred)

Action items I need from each of you:
- Laura: confirmation on final comp and any manager-level contingencies (relocation stipend, if approved).
- Monica: please confirm the standard PTO accrual start date and any onboarding paperwork requirements that would affect start timing.
- Marcus: please sign off on equity bucket and any sign-on bonus exception (we discussed a $10k sign-on if they request).
- Tessa: once legal signs off I will schedule a 25–30 minute offer call (video) with Sophie and generate the DocuSign envelope for signature.

I've attached the provisional offer PDF I will send if we get sign-off (Offer_Initial_SophiePark_20270220.pdf). If legal has redlines, please route Eric Liu (external counsel) as needed — tagging him here would be fine once we have manager sign-off.

Target timeline: internal approvals this week so we can run the offer call next week. Sophie provided availability windows below in a separate note (I'll forward when she confirms).

Thanks,
Logan

2) DocuSign: I prefer DocuSign for signature (email is fine).
3) Relocation: I won't be relocating immediately; I will be remote in the Bay Area.

- Wed 02/24: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–17:00

Hi Sophie — thanks for the quick replies and flexibility.

Confirming next steps:
- Offer call (video) scheduled: Tue, 2027-03-02 at 10:30 AM PST — calendar invite sent to your email. Please let me know if that needs to be moved.
- We incorporated Laura's manager redlines and legal's quick pass. Attached is the final offer PDF that will be sent via DocuSign (Offer_Final_SophiePark_20270228.pdf).
- DocuSign envelope will arrive from noreply@docusign.com with envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d-ef45-6789-0123-abcdef456789. The envelope will include the offer and the standard employee acknowledgment form. Signing can be completed on mobile or desktop.
- Start date: we kept the target as 2027-03-29 but noted Sophie's preference for 3/22 if paperwork completes sooner. Monica will confirm payroll/benefits start for either date.

Monica: please confirm PTO accrual start and whether insurance eligibility on 1st of month rules would push the effective benefits date if Sophie starts 3/22. If we need to move signing to accommodate benefits, we'll surface that on the offer call.

Laura/Marcus: please let me know if you want the offer call to include a brief manager intro (5 minutes) or for it to be just you + Sophie for questions. I can have the manager on for the first 10 minutes.

Sophie — once you sign the DocuSign envelope we'll confirm the official start and I will send onboarding next steps (IT account form, W-4, direct deposit).

Thanks everyone — excited to close this out.

Best,
Logan
